notes.title: Park Bound 1.8.0-1.8.8 Released
notes.content:
1.8.0

Add new particle effects options in level editor
Fixed bug causing treasure podiums with nine or more stars to display incorrectly
Updated Steamworks SDK

Update is required to play recently uploaded parks or with other players on 1.8.0+. Players with older versions will be split into their own sectors.


1.8.1

Moved Lantern Festival event forward to February 1 - February 20
Events now start at 6 AM EST instead of 6 PM EST



1.8.2

Added support for players to create multiple parks


1.8.3

Enabled option to set teleport receivers to be invisible or uncollidable in level editor
Fixed bug causing gyroball collision sound effect playing while jumping


1.8.4

Added feature to reset progress made in a park. If you reset your progress after completing all chests in the park you will earn a prestige point for that park to track the number of times you completed a park. This feature is accessible through the "info" button in each park from the park overworld.


1.8.5

Fixed bug causing camera to not move smoothly when immediately jumping after landing on higher platform
Fixed bug causing some objects to be rendered when not in camera view
Editor: Added ability to restore deleted zones from an uploaded park. Under the Upload tab, right click on the icon of any zone shown in the "Removed" section and press restore.


1.8.6

Fixed bug in the level editor where meshes with too many triangles could trigger crash under some conditions.


1.8.7

Editor - Zone entrance button in park now applies all material properties instead of just color.
Editor - Zone screens collidability / visibility can now be configured.


1.8.8

Fixed issue with 1.8.7 update causing some player parks to not load correctly.

notes.title: Park Bound 1.7.5 Released
notes.content:
1.7.5

Players with Windows operating systems now use the 64-bit version of the game by default. This version has improved load times and has significantly improved performance on large levels. 
Fixed bug that could cause sound effects to play incorrectly on some hardware configurations.
Fixed bug causing morphing shapes with attached objects to render incorrectly in the level editor.

Note: Mac and Linux operating systems already use the 64-bit version. The Windows 32-bit version is still available to use under the debug build of the game. If you have any issues playing the latest version please make a post on the Bugs & Technical help forum.

notes.title: Lantern Festival and 1.7.0 released
notes.content:
Update is required to play recently uploaded parks or with other players on 1.7.0. Players with older versions will be split into their own sectors.

Game

Added a Lantern Festival event available until February 21. Complete the challenge to unlock a new hat!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1294678755
Added a Wild West event, available from March 7 - March 21.
Added a message when trying to activate a zone portal that was configured to have no destination.
Added a new Archived tag for parks in the Steam Workshop. Parks that are empty, unnamed, or broken may be marked as archived. Archived parks won't show up on the overworld signs or in the popular section of the park browser. They will still be accessible through the browse section and will show up in the park activity list if someone is in it. Updating the park will automatically remove the archived tag.


Editor

Added a new teleport field object created from the teleport receiver. Touching the field will bring players to the receiver.
Fixed bug where teleport sender material would be linked to the teleport receiver until the level was reopened.
Fixed bug where prefabs containing an inside morph component wouldn't load correctly under some situations.

notes.title: Launching tomorrow, 1.4.7 & 1.4.8 released
notes.content:
Park Bound will be leaving Early Access and launching tomorrow at 17:00 GMT (11:00 AM CST). Thanks everyone who participated in Early Access. It has been great to play with you all in-game, see your screenshots/videos, and explore the community created parks. Hope to see you there on launch! Also, update 1.4.7 is released to include various editor fixes and improvements.

Game

Updated park browser icons and overworld console.

Editor

Fixed bug causing the select mode interface to sometimes show the incorrect mode after refresh.
Fixed grid snapping not applying correctly when drag-translating if grid size was greater than one.
Fixed bug causing global bounding box to be displayed incorrectly under some situations.
Fixed bug causing interpolation menu to sometimes not close correctly when selecting new object.
Fixed bug causing undo-redo system to work incorrectly after creating a new level.
Re-ordered rotation hotkey menu controls. Removed confirm button icon until axis selected.
Fixed bug causing objects created by a decompiling a prefab to be positioned incorrectly if they weren't previously attached.
Decompiling a prefab will now add an undo save point.
Updated color hex field to accept strings of 6 characters even if the field supports an alpha channel (8 characters).
Fixed color hex field to maintain cursor position when typing.
Fixed bug causing environment mixer menu to open when editing a prefab.



1.4.8
Editor

Fixed bug introduced in 1.4.7 that would cause an error if a prefab was decompiled within another prefab.

notes.title: To The Skies event, 1.4.4 released
notes.content:
To The Skies

The overworld has taken flight! Complete the event challenge to unlock a special hat. The overworld will land on the beach again on November 18th.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1189179543

1.4.1

Editor

If the camera is inside the selected object bounding box then it is no longer clickable (making it easier to select other objects).
Capsules shapes now use tight bounds instead of maximum bounds for bounding box calculation when inside a prefab.
Fixed bug that could cause the bounding box to become unclickable until the level was refreshed.
Fixed rotating by global axis not giving correct output under some situations.

New Transform Menu

Can drag the object bounds to translate, rotate, or scale. If scale mode is selected and object is unscalable it will default to translate (prefabs for example).
Display for global vs local axis. Uses exiting hotkey for toggling axis (tab by default).
Enable/disable grid snap. Can still hold toggle key to temporarily enable or disable (ctrl by default).
Buttons for changing grid snap size and new hotkeys (left/right bracket by default).
Advanced mode will show a smaller menu without labels.


1.4.2
Game

Fixed bug allowing levels to place multiple treasure chests causing the game to freeze when opened.

Editor

Fixed bug causing prefabs to distort the screen if shadows were disabled.



1.4.3
Editor

Fixed bug causing grid settings to load incorrectly if grid toggle key was held down when level loaded.
Fixed editor crash that could be caused by entering rotate mode.
Fixed editor crash when adding divisions to a ramp if the shapeline only had one point.


1.4.4
Game

Fixed bug where other players inside ball using first person mode would display incorrectly.
Editor

Fixed bug where using delete single object (ctrl+shift+x) wouldn't remove prefabs correctly.
Fixed bug when changing chat color would crash the level.

notes.title: Park Bound 1.3.2 released
notes.content:
Game

Stepping on a zone button will show the player count if at least one player is in the zone.
Players can now enter a locked zone if there is at least one other player active in the zone. If the zone is empty the requirements must be met before entering. The upcoming 1.4.0 update will add a level editor option that can make the requirements mandatory for specific zones.
Added the ability to enter active zones in the park activity menu (must be in the park entrance).
Added gamepad mouse simulation for menus (except level editor).
Added an arrow showing how to enter parks in the overworld the first time the game is played.

Build

Added the ability to copy a zone on the right-click menu. The copied level will receive a new internal ID, so if added to the park it will be considered a different level for zone completion.

notes.title: Halloween Event and update 1.3.1 released
notes.content:
Halloween

Halloween decorations have brought ghosts to the overworld - complete the coin challenge to unlock a special Halloween hat!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1189187723
Game

Added support for overworld events where players can unlock unique outfit options.
Updated the camera to avoid collisions with the ground and to adjust the zoom level if a collision with an object near the camera could be avoided.
Added support for items with two button inputs. Default item auxiliary hotkey is shift for keyboard and left trigger for gamepads.
Added interface showing the keyboard controls for an item when standing on the item pad.
Changed glider activation to auxiliary item hotkey.
Added new Speed Boost item - try it out in the main park where you can find it near Star Pier.
Added gyroball collision sound effects.
Added glider wind sound effects.
Added text wrapping for notifications with long zone names.

Editor

Major performance improvement when rendering prefab button previews.
Added ability to rotate prefab buttons previews by right clicking and dragging. Prefab previews no longer spin continuously.
Changed prefab buttons previews to use the default lighting.
Added support to use zone generation when editing prefabs by using the destroy/generate action.
Added ability to enter practice mode while editing prefabs.
Added ability to modify spline points in the scene directly.
Added sound object outlines when the sound panel is open.
Added particle object outlines when the particle panel is open.
Fixed crash in practice mode if the hotkey to show player names was pressed.

Engine

Particles now render after transparent meshes providing better transparency sorting in most situations.



The overworld will return to normal after Halloween - but a permanent Halloween level will be added to the main park later in October.

notes.title: Park Bound 1.3.0 released
notes.content:
Update is required to play recently uploaded parks or with other players on 1.3.0. Players with older versions will be split into their own sectors.

Game

Added Community section in park browser for voting and subscribing to parks.
Changed overworld and browser park sorting to be based on the park score.
Subscribing to a park now shows the total treasures collected in the park browser. Also, the browser will show a plus icon when a new zone is added to a subscribed park. Must to enter the park at least once after 1.3.0 to display new interface.
Added text wrapping for 3D text above characters for long chat messages.

Build

Added ability to revert a zone to the active version  in the park by right clicking on zone button.
Updated zone button style and added text wrapping for long level names.

Editor

Added new level generation tool for new levels. See the forum post.
Added dedicated menu for library selection on the add panel. If the library name starts with a number then number will be hidden on the library page.
Separated engine objects (previously named core) to it's own button in the add menu.
Library prefab buttons now show names on mouse-over (if a name was given). Names are also imported when adding to level.
Added the option to make conveyors four sided.
Added a hide UI hotkey (default CTRL+SHIFT+H).
Added OpenSimplex terrain algorithm.
Added edges/bottom options to terraced terrain.
Changed the "Remove Unused" categories to be all be checked by default.
Setting rocket fuel less than or equal to 0 will give now give player infinite fuel and hide fuel interface.
Added help message when setting zone music if no music was subscribed or uploaded.
Fixed environment gradient button not showing in simplified editor mode.
Fixed bug causing surface-cloned objects to be positioned incorrectly under rare situations.
Fixed painted prefabs not showing new materials until next refresh when "painted full".
Fixed block terrain type not clamping correctly.
Fixed conveyors not animating until next refresh when assigning new timeline.
Fixed prefab panel rebuilding menu each time an object was added or removed in the scene.
Fixed environment buttons not showing correct gradient if sky colors were recently re-ordered.
Fixed back button sometimes returning to empty menu.

notes.title: Park Bound 1.1.1 & 1.1.2 released
notes.content:
Version 1.1.1

Game

Fixed player not landing correctly on fast-falling platforms
Fixed jittering caused when standing between two sloped surfaces
Reduced stuttering for other players' characters when either player had a weak network connection
Fixed double jump flames not activating on other characters

Menus

Updated splash screen title text



Version 1.1.2

Game

Fixed bug introduced in 1.1.1 causing gryoballs to not move correctly with platforms 

Overworld

Overworld billboards now fade-in park images if world loads before screenshots are available


Note: Version 1.1.1 fixed an issue where it would take an extra frame for the player to register a connection with the platform when touching a new surface. This was mostly only noticeable on falling platforms (such as swings) where the player would sometimes touch the platform but not continue to move on it. Version 1.1.2 fixes an issue (unrelated, but introduced in 1.1.1) that caused the gyroball to not move with a moving platform correctly under any situation. However, because the player (under all items) now correctly connects to the platforms right away, the gyroball may interact slightly different under some extreme edge cases.

notes.title: Park Bound 1.0.3 released
notes.content:
Gryoball improvements, conveyor fixes, and minor optimizations.

Gameplay

Fixed conveyors moving the player incorrectly when using a non-zero prefab offset (not observable in existing levels)
Gyroball airborne fixes and improvements - this was large enough for it's own post, see the Steam community forum post for details 


Engine

Optimized uncollidable morphing shapes (If all objects linked to a morphing shape are marked as uncollidable the engine can skip bounds recalculation for the underlying physics shape. The most common use-case is water-like morphing shapes that can use a simplified box shape for their collision in many situations)
